provenance.evolution_rule: retain source identity and differences; do not promote one-off success into global policy

rights.activation_rule: do not execute or redistribute a source asset until its exact source and license are admitted

role_contract.trigger: Aji task-specific selection; assignment must name the concrete task trigger
role_contract.anti_trigger: required from each role record; matching anti_trigger means do not activate
role_contract.inputs: five_elements.inputs plus exact authorized input references
role_contract.scope: explicit task write_roots and forbidden_actions; never inferred from catalog membership
role_contract.dependencies: composition_dependencies are design references, not runtime dependencies unless resolved for this task

admitted_roles.scope: Current project-local Windows code animation creation and one actual browser-comment revision

evidence.limitation: Local ignored evidence; re-observe on another machine or after runtime/source changes

upstream.name: huashu-motion
upstream.license: MIT; retain bundled-component exceptions and THIRD_PARTY.md notices

host_capabilities.native_spawn: current-session-only; host capability must be observed at invocation
